articles.title: Hardoi Sensation: Missing for 7 Years, Man Found in Viral Reel With Another Woman
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a bizarre twist from Hardoi’s Sandila area, a woman identified her missing husband through a viral reel on social media—seven years after he disappeared. According to the woman, Sheelu from Murarnagar, she married Jitendra Kumar alias Bablu in April 2017.

body.html:
In a bizarre twist from Hardoi’s Sandila area, a woman identified her missing husband through a viral reel on social media—seven years after he disappeared.

According to the woman, Sheelu from Murarnagar, she married Jitendra Kumar alias Bablu in April 2017. Soon after marriage, her husband and in-laws allegedly harassed her for dowry, demanding a gold chain and a ring. When the demand was not fulfilled, she was thrown out of the house.

In 2018, Bablu went missing during a dowry harassment investigation. His family accused Sheelu’s side of killing him. However, seven years later, Sheelu spotted Bablu in a viral reel, living with another woman in Ludhiana, Punjab. She claims he has remarried and abandoned her and their son.

The wife submitted the reel and photos to police, alleging fraud and harassment. Police have registered a case and launched a search for Bablu. Officials confirmed action will be taken after his arrest.

articles.title: Ghaziabad Row: Husband Alleges Wife’s Instagram Reels Behind Marital Discord, Claims Knife Attack
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A bizarre family dispute in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, has turned violent after social media addiction allegedly caused a rift between a couple.

body.html:
A bizarre family dispute in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, has turned violent after social media addiction allegedly caused a rift between a couple.

According to the complaint filed, 29-year-old Anis alleged that his wife Ishrat spends most of her time making Instagram reels, neglecting household responsibilities and frequently interacting with other men online. He claimed that whenever he questioned her, she became aggressive, threatened suicide, and even filed a police complaint against him and his family.

Anis further alleged that during one such confrontation, Ishrat attacked him with a knife. He also submitted a video of her brandishing the weapon along with his complaint. The couple, married since 2009, has two children aged nine and six.

Police confirmed that a case has been registered based on Anis’s complaint and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Polish F-16 Crash Horror: Star Pilot Dies During Radom Airshow Rehearsal, Event Cancelled
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Radom, Poland – A Polish Air Force F-16 fighter jet crashed during rehearsals for the Radom Airshow on August 28, 2025, killing the pilot, Major Maciej “SLAB” Krakowian, a renowned display pilot from the F-16 Tiger Demo Team.

body.html:
Radom, Poland – A Polish Air Force F-16 fighter jet crashed during rehearsals for the Radom Airshow on August 28, 2025, killing the pilot, Major Maciej “SLAB” Krakowian, a renowned display pilot from the F-16 Tiger Demo Team.

The crash occurred around 7:25 pm at Radom Air Base while the aircraft was performing an aerobatic manoeuvre. Eyewitness footage showed the jet entering a barrel roll or descending steeply before hitting the runway and bursting into flames. There was no sign of an ejection attempt.

Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz, who visited the crash site, called the incident “a great loss for the Air Force and the entire Polish Army,” while offering condolences to the pilot’s family.

Authorities confirmed no injuries on the ground. However, the Radom Airshow, one of Poland’s largest aviation events, was immediately cancelled.

The aircraft belonged to the 31st Tactical Air Base near Poznan and was part of Poland’s NATO-oriented modernised fleet. Military investigators are probing the cause of the crash.

The tragedy has shaken Poland’s armed forces and drawn widespread condolences from government officials, service members, and the international community.

body.html:
Agra, UP – A shocking case has come to light after a 3–4 day old newborn girl was abandoned near NH-19 in Kuberpur. Eyewitnesses said a man and a woman arrived on a bike and fled after throwing the infant in a field.

Authorities are scanning CCTV footage to identify and trace those who abandoned the girl.
